notes.title: UPDATE: Login Changes / First Person
notes.content:
Sorry for the lack of updates!  We've taken to heart a lot of what was said and we wanted to take time to fix what we could. When we launched and things went sideways, we were all a bit bummed. We just needed some time to rest with our families and refocus on life.

So, what does this mean for GiT? We've decided as a group that we're going to put less effort into developing new content for the time being.  However that doesn't mean that we're stopping altogether. We'll continue to support the game as it is, fix issues here and there, especially any game breaking ones.

If you want to support us during that time - we're more than willing to accept any help! You can make donations via PayPal to donations@frontwirestudios.com - any donations will 100% go towards the development and support of the game. From updates, to bug fixes, future content and server costs. 

 We do have a few more updates to the game including some game modes in the coming weeks. The first of which was just released.

Here is one of our final big updates to the game! 

Changes in this build:

- We have [b]REMOVED [/b]the login requirement. The community was torn about having to make a Frontwire Account to play the game. So now you'll be auto-logged in via STEAM when you launch. 

- New ambient sfx in the maps thanks to @pumodi 

- Nametags are now added in thanks to @Jorge III 

- The AI has been overhauled! AI have new logic that prevents hiccups and issues on servers and when playing P2P.

- On Domination, team colors have been fixed! You should now properly see your team as one color and the other team as red. 

- A new space-only map! Now under the TDM Game Mode you can select "CTS Space TDM".

- Maps have had a lighting overhaul as we moved to the latest UE4 version!

- [b]Finally First Person cockpit views are now in the TDM Space map thanks to Zaidenknop & Vorixo! (See the video below)[/b]

[previewyoutube=IWAndMI0F3o;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: GAME UPDATE: New Game Mode!
notes.content:
Hello GiT Community!

 For starters, I wanted to thank you all for checking out the early access release. While I know that there have been mixed reviews on what we have done so far, I still want to express the entire team's appreciation for each and every review, positive or negative. The positive reviews help us keep chugging along. The negative ones help us see what needs to be corrected. For those of you who have left negative review, I promise that we are reading each review, and that we're doing everything we can to turn the negative reviews into positive ones.

Before I go into the update, I invite you all to join us on Discord. You can jump into the discussion with the entire community and the development team, and get your opinions heard to help us out with the development of GiT! Discord: https://discord.gg/galaxyinturmoil

With that being said, our first major update is now live! This update includes a new game mode, [u][b]Domination[/b][/u]. It's a capture the control point style game mode. Read on for details about the game mode.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/zqQJrej.gif[/img]

[h2][b]What is DOMINATION?[/b][/h2]
In Domination, opposing factions compete for control of the area. By capturing Control Posts on the map, players boost their team’s total capture score and open up additional team spawn locations for further conquest.

The longer a team holds a Control Post, the more points it earns. Victory goes to the team that first reaches the target points threshold.

[i][b]This update also includes two vehicles: A hover bike and a (wip) tank. Friendly note: The tank requires two people! A driver and a gunner. The gunner can access the turret from the back of the tank![/b][/i]

Everything you need to know about the game mode, and how to play is currently found in two spots:

1. The loadout screen gives you a breakdown of objectives on the right
2. When you approach healing stations, ammo stations or the capture point, a tool tip will show in the top right of the screen (See the above gif for reference)
------------

While there are bots on the server, we are aware of a bug where they can get a bit janky and sit in the spawn for a bit. However if they get attacked/killed, they resume operating as normal. We're looking into a quick patch for this in the coming days. However until then, you can still play with your friends!

Likewise in the coming days we'll be releasing public leaderboards! So get in game and start learning the functions and controls so you can make it to the top 50!

In closing, I know people have expectations for ground to space. 
We do have it, and we plan to drip release it, along with new maps very soon. 

[i][b]See you in game and on Discord! 

<3 Fergie & The Dev Team[/b][/i]

notes.title: Community Update + Patch Notes v1578
notes.content:
Patch Notes for v1578

Hey there GiT community!

I hope you had a KILLER Christmas/Hanukkah/Kwanzaa/Whatever it is you celebrate!

Every year people ask me what I want for Christmas. Normally I reply; “my two front teeth“, but this Christmas I asked asked for something special. Our Kickstarter is now live! Even though the Holidays are just about over –  If you’re still in the giving spirit, be sure to check it out and back us! <3

Before I get into the patch notes for v1578, I wanted to take the moment to address the elephant in the room: Server population. As you may (or may not) know, we’ve had a drastic issue with server population. It’s practically non-existent. When we launched the demo, we fully expected tons of players to roll through the door – they didn’t. We scratched our heads, pulled out our hair, and then we figured out why!

As you know, we’ve released the DEMO on Steam. The issue, however, is that when the demo was released, the over 100,000+ people who have GiT on their wishlist didn’t get a notification.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/12luQDyqvum5l6/200w_d.gif[/img]

That’s right! It seems even though hundreds of thousands of people have GiT on their wishlists, they won’t receive notifications of demo launches unless the demo is also on their wishlist. As such, we’ve been receiving tons of emails and DM’s asking when the demo will drop, even though it already has.

In order to rememedy this, we’re working with Valve to re-release the demo as Early-Access, in order to get that golden ticket (read: marketing email) sent to the over 100,000+ people who have been waiting for the demo to drop!

 

 
With that being said – lets talk about this latest patch!

For this update, we’ve really worked hard on fixing a lot of the issues that arose with the initial launch of the demo. We’ve also listened to the community feedback and done our best to address one big issue. Our very own Christmas elf, Vorixo, worked his little elf fingers to the bone on Christmas Day and created a basic AI system to help with server population as people continue to learn about GiT. So our belated gift to all of you – bots!

Three modes now have bots on them by default. We’re currently working to add an option to enable or disabled bots in the server settings screen, but that is not in this current patch. Bots are now added in by default on the following modes:

    TDM
    Domination
    Siege (Bowels Map)

We’re hoping to add the bots to other gamemodes – but for now, Domination,TDM and Siege (Bowels map) are the only gameodes that have the bots enabled. There are a slew of other updates and fixes that we’ve deployed in this patch, so be sure to read on and then hop on GiT and check them out!

One final note – we’re going to be coordinating some in-game community events in the coming week(s) so keep an eye on the News channel on our Discord server. Link: https://discord.gg/galaxyinturmoil

 
AUDIO

– Ambient sounds added to the following: Shields, Depots, Capture Points, Shield Generators, Comm Capital Ship Gun, Teeth Spinner

– [HOTFIX] Added missing attenuation settings to weapons

– [CHANGE] Adjusted atmosphere ambience and missile firing sounds

– Added wind sounds when entering the atmosphere from space

– Added in various ambient loops to Amalgam

– Added the Comm announcer (This means you Comm Bois can now hear objectives and directions. Subtitles coming soon)

 
VEHICLES

– Improved ship latency compensation (ty Mookie <3)

 
UI

– [HOTFIX] Extraction zones on siege will now show a timer during the egg extraction

– A register button has been added to the login screen

– First iteration of the victory/loss cutscenes for Invasion Mode have been implemented
MISC

– Fixed the buggy Domination spawn points on Amalgam

– Added basic bots (YAY) to TDM and Domination maps. The bots roam around, jump, and do bot-stuff. Bots also have one of 4 different weapons they will spawn with.

notes.title: Patch Notes v1575
notes.content:
Patch Notes for v1575
NOTE: You may need to restart Steam in order to see the update in your downloads.

 
UI

– [HOTFIX] Fixed an issue where the kill feed showed up in the middle of the screen

 
BALANCING

– [FIX] Matched Comm Clutch crosshair behaviour to Vori Clutch (increased speed of crosshair closing)

– Flak turret rotation and elevation speed increased as it was losing duels vs. Starfighters that it quite frankly shouldn’t.

– Clutch grenade velocity increased significantly to improve its effectiveness at range.

– Clutch grenade gravity set to 1x, previously 0.35x, to compensate for this change.

– Clutch grenade initial velocity now has a small upwards component, effectively zeroing the Clutch. (You don’t have to aim as high anymore, basically.)

 
VEHICLES

– Handling tweaked to be more intuitive and snappy. Especially on the hoverbike.

– Camera smoothing decreased significantly.

 
MISC

– Changed kill message of Clutch from “Clutch Grenade” to just “Clutch”.

– Adjusted minimap zoom levels based on player velocity to zoom out less as you can’t see anything if you gotta go fast!

– Small Amalgam landscape tweaks

– Reversed teams on Marshland Domination.

notes.title: Demo Release!
notes.content:
We’re super pumped to finally welcome you to the Galaxy in Turmoil Conceptual Demo! We’ve come this far on pizza, energy drinks and volunteer efforts. Now imagine how much further we could go if we could afford to work on the game full-time, and even hire some new team members!

The demo is now available for download on Steam. Likewise, our Kickstarter campaign is now officially live! This campaign provides a full development roadmap, spanning years of development and content. If you enjoy the demo, we’d love for you to back us on Kickstarter. With YOUR help, we can create a franchise that is free of gambling and pay-to-win. A true, community focused franchise.


With that being said, there are a few items you should know about:

•••>>>    Our Kickstarter is now LIVE! Check it out and consider backing us! :heart: [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/git/galaxy-in-turmoil]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/git/galaxy-in-turmoil[/url]<<<•••

   • Don't forget to share the demo and Kickstarter with your family and friends! Also be sure to blast it on social media and share it with your favorite YouTuber's!

   • In order to play the Galaxy in Turmoil Conceptual Demo, you will need both a Steam account and a Frontwire Studios account. Frontwire accounts can be created for free at https://auth.frontwirestudios.com/

   • There are a few known issues with the current version, they can be found at http://galaxyinturmoil.com/

   • Our Community Forums are now live. Feel free to hop on and chat with us at https://community.galaxyinturmoil.com/ 

   • If you encounter any issues, please do not hesitate to open a ticket by emailing support@frontwirestudios.com – our team is standing by to help out in any way possible

From everyone here at the Frontwire team, we hope you enjoy a glimpse into our idea for Galaxy in Turmoil! We couldn’t have made it this far without your continued support and good vibes!

notes.title: Always on the Search for new Bunnies
notes.content:
Hello everybody! As you know we anticipate to be able to release the demo for Galaxy in Turmoil in 2019, however there's still plenty of stress tests for larger player counts that we have to do before it's ready for the public. So, if you are interested and don't mind signing an NDA, head on over to our [url=https://tester.frontwirestudios.com/]tester application form[/url]. If you've got any questions about the testing process, the NDA or just the game in general you can chat with the community and the developers at our [url=https://discord.gg/galaxyinturmoil]Discord[/url]!

Weekly testing always takes place on Sunday at 1 PM EST, however we will have several test sessions throughout the week as well.

To reiterate some of the benefits and requirements of being a test bunny;

[b]Benefits[/b]
[list]
[*] The dope Test Bunnies :rabbit: role in [url=https://discord.gg/galaxyinturmoil]Discord[/url]
[*] A private Discord server where you can chat one-on-one with the development team
[*] A special role on our (soon to be launched) community forums & Reddit
[/list]

[b]Requirements[/b]

[list]
[*] You must be at least 18 or older to apply (You'll be required to sign an NDA and provide a photo ID)

[/list]

notes.title: Shh, I'm hunting for test bunnies!
notes.content:
As we continue to chug along with developing Galaxy in Turmoil, we have finally come to a point where we are needing to add more people to our Test Bunnies team. Normally we add around 20 - 30 people at a time, however it's time to go big or go home! I'm super excited to announce that we're looking to add 200 new people to our tester team! 

What is the test bunny program and what do I get if I join?
The Test Bunny program is an exclusive group of Galaxy in Turmoil fans that get to test game as we develop it. You get to attempt to break newly implemented features while also providing feedback on existing and prototyped features.

Some cool perks:
[list]
[*]The dope @Test Bunnies 🐰 role in Discord
[*]A private Discord server where you can chat one-on-one with the development team
[*]A special role on our (soon to be launched) community forums & Reddit
[/list]

Requirements
Just to note, there are a few requirements that need to be met if you're going to become a Test Bunny:
[list]
[*] You must be at least 18 or older to apply (You'll be required to sign an NDA and provide a photo ID)
[*] You must be able to make at LEAST 2 tests per-month minimum. Tests are typically held on Sunday's at 1PM EST
[*] You must READ and WRITE fluent English. Bunnies are required to fill out written bug reports on our bug tracker
[*] You MUST have a working microphone and speak some-what fluent English, or at least have a solid understanding of spoken English. Bunnies are required to hop (heh)  in voice chat with the dev team to coordinate testing
[/list]

If you're interested in joining the elite Test Bunnies crew, head over to http://survey.frontwirestudios.com/ and fill out the application! 
FYI: Applying does not mean you'll automatically join the team. We'll review each application and depending on a variety of factors, we'll reach out via email if you are picked!

notes.title: Development Update & FAQ
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25294993/e6f1750aa697ee6984c54c8acb1a00ec717941c8.png[/img]

It’s been quite some time since we last updated you guys on the status of development, which is why we wanted to take a moment to give a quick update and answer any questions that you might have.

In short, we’re still working on development by the day. Whilst we’re still not ready to commit to a final release date for the upcoming demo, we can say with confidence that we’re a hell of a lot closer than we were before!

Over the past months, we’ve been working a lot on polishing gameplay mechanics and UI elements such as the in-game HUD, building assets for use in multiplayer levels, as well as polishing combat animations.

Since you've last heard from us we've implemented the following (among many other things):
[list]
[*]A fully functional class system, each class with their own equipment selections and traits.
[*]Various deployable equipment types including teleporters and medical bots.
[*]Tanks and Hoverbikes galore!
[*]Atmospheric entry and exit VFX.
[*]Multiple Playable Vori races.
[*]Homing missiles for Fighters.
[*]Destroyed ship debris.
[*]Anti-Infantry and Anti-Air turrets.
[*]And much more...
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25294993/6e69ac83cb18bd2f2dff954ed6a378d28cd1a940.gif[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25294993/cb7e3c56709b03d2d5cf5be123cefcc7fb034ac0.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25294993/45b5961b6fc66b4d785d514d9aceb338bd30bcc5.gif[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25294993/0aa764589e2490d7d1510c686a3f20ddfc8d00f5.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25294993/a7311054eb61d0e8bbed42e20489ff0b8c182d59.gif[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25294993/d47a03802ccbafdccd89587bd440c06809c2045a.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25294993/2ffce202a38f584bd64b14b1a4d55e00e03e2ba5.gif[/img]

We’ve also taken the time to throw together a long overdue FAQ which we hope will give appropriately in-depth answers to whatever other questions you might have about the status of the conceptual demo or just about our plans for Galaxy in Turmoil in general.

So, without further ado:

[b][h1]Galaxy in Turmoil: Frequently Asked Questions.[/h1][/b]
[b]What is Galaxy in Turmoil?[/b]
[list]
[*] Galaxy in Turmoil is a space-faring, scenario-based multiplayer game in the Combined Arms genre. Set in a Cyberpunk-flavored universe with a little bit of Fantasy thrown into the mix, the game features seamless space-to-ground combat, both in and out of vehicles.

Need to take down a shield generator to advance your team's objective? Sneak in on foot and plant some remote explosives or hop in a starfighter and carry out bombing runs. If you're so inclined, you can even grab a tank and storm right into the enemy base. Want to disable that pesky capital ship that's scraping the upper atmosphere? Strap into a pilot seat and soar up through the clouds. The choice is yours!

Being an eclectic lot of gamers ourselves, we've drawn artistic, thematic, and gameplay-related inspiration from a wide range of titles, including the classic Star Wars: Battlefront, Warhawk and Starhawk, Bioshock, Star Fox, Mass Effect, Dark Souls, and even a few quirkier gems like Oddworld: Abe's Oddysee. We've enjoyed creating our own unique universe and can't wait to share it with the world.
[/list]
[b]Is Galaxy in Turmoil still in development?[/b]
[list]
[*] Yes, work on Galaxy in Turmoil continues by the day. You can keep track of our progress in real time by joining our [url=https://discord.gg/galaxyinturmoil]Discord server[/url] where we have made our internal commit logs public for all to see! 
 
[i]Please note that the commit log only displays direct updates made to the playable build. It does not record more behind-the-scenes work, such as asset creation or developer tests run on local computers.[/i]
[/list]
[b]Is Galaxy in Turmoil a Star Wars game?[/b]
[list]
[*] No. While it’s true that the project started out as a Star Wars fan game, we have long since pivoted away from that to instead build something of our own design, set in a universe of our own making. Doing so has given us the opportunity to exercise full creative freedom and work to create something new.
[/list]
[b]When will Galaxy in Turmoil be released?[/b]
[list]
[*] We’re currently working on an upcoming demo to give you guys a glimpse of what we have planned for Galaxy in Turmoil. We plan to launch this demo alongside a Kickstarter campaign to fund the development of the game. There is no current ETA on the upcoming Demo or the full game.
[/list]
[b]How much will Galaxy in Turmoil cost?[/b]
[list]
[*] The multiplayer release of Galaxy in Turmoil, just like the upcoming demo, will be free! The pricing of the singleplayer release will be announced later down the line.
[/list]
[b]What will the upcoming Demo Contain?[/b]
[list]
[*] There are currently 4 multiplayer game modes planned for the upcoming demo, along with several maps. Please note that game modes featured in this demo are not the only experiences we hope to offer in the full game.

[list]
[*][b]Team Deathmatch:[/b]
[code]You know the drill. What shooter game would be complete without a little team-based mayhem? 2 teams square off against each other. Your objective? Destroy all enemies![/code]
[*][b]Domination:[/b]
[code]In Domination Mode, opposing factions compete for control of the area. By capturing nodes on the map, players boost their team’s total capture score and open up additional team spawn locations for further conquest.

On larger maps, players may utilize an assortment of vehicles, from tanks to aerial fighters, and access defensive tech, such as anti-aircraft turrets.

The longer a team holds a control node, the more domination points it earns. Victory goes to the team that first reaches the target points threshold.[/code]
[*][b]Siege:[/b]
[code]In Siege Mode, the defending team’s base houses a rare and valuable artifact. The attacking team must break through all security before they can take the payload for themselves. Security defenses may include shields and antipersonnel turrets.

In the most common derivation of Siege, attackers must hack through three security consoles to lower the defending team’s shields. Defenders must prevent or intercept hacks to cancel the hack before it completes. Once all consoles are hacked, the shield protecting the artifact vanishes, leaving it vulnerable to a full-on assault. To achieve victory, attackers must carry the artifact to one of their Extraction Zones, while defenders try to stop them until the timer runs out.[/code]
[*][b]Invasion:[/b]
[code]A Comm Industries Tower Ship has launched an assault on a Vori-controlled world, aiming its most dangerous weapon at the ground far below. However, the Vori Legion never comes to the battle unprepared, having previously installed powerful shields that dissipate energy from Comm weaponry. Until the Vori shield generators are destroyed, the ship’s cannon will be unable to target its primary objectives.
 
From their starting point in the Tower Ship, Comm starfighters must descend through the planet’s atmosphere to target Vori shield generators on the ground. This may not be an easy task, as Vori bases are host to powerful anti-aircraft turrets that can shred a ship in seconds. Should the Comm succeed in taking down all Vori shields, their cannon will begin warming up to fire. Successfully firing the cannon results in victory for the Comm.

For the Vori, losing shields isn’t automatically the end. Before the cannon fires, Vori starfighters may fly into space, work their way up through multiple levels of the Tower Ship to take out the Comm’s own internal shield generators, and finally target the cannon itself. Even with no shields left on the ground, the Vori will have a few precious minutes to launch an all-out assault on the Tower Ship and steal victory from the Comm.

Winning Invasion mode requires each team to carefully balance offense and defense. This includes capturing control nodes both on the ground and in space to provide team members with additional spawn locations that may be closer to objectives than the default deployment zones.[/code][/list][/list]
[b]There has been talk of a gameplay teaser, what’s going on with that?[/b]
[list]
[*] While we have released a teaser on our [url=https://youtu.be/Vl_iOjIvZ90]YouTube channel[/url], we’re currently at a stage in development where visual changes can still happen. If, for example, we had released footage of these maps months earlier, it would have been vastly inferior to what we ended up publishing. Because of this, we don’t want to rush into making any more teasers until the game’s visuals are more stable.
[/list]
[b]Are there plans for splitscreen “instant action”-esque bot battles?[/b]
[list]
[*] There are no plans for bots or splitscreen gameplay in the upcoming demo, but it’s something we’re more than open to exploring in the full game if there is demand for it.
[/list]
[b]Will there be Heroes or any kind of similar Elite Classes?[/b]
[list]
[*] Galaxy in Turmoil does indeed feature an as-yet-unnamed elite system. In most multiplayer modes, players will be able to spawn as named characters from our story campaign and beyond, and it goes without saying that they’ll be tough to take down alone!
[/list]
[b]Will there be a singleplayer campaign? What will it be about?[/b]
[list]
[*] The singleplayer campaign gives us a view of the burgeoning war between Comm Industries and the Vori Federation, the two most powerful factions in the known galaxy. Told through the eyes of Roka, a plucky mercenary with a history of taking on the most dangerous jobs, the story leads us through branching scenarios driven by player action and choice.

While Roka may seem devil-may-care at times, her motivations run deep. We hope players will enjoy not only learning details of Roka's backstory, but also helping her carve out a future for herself during a tumultuous moment in history.
[/list]
[b]What type of gameplay can we expect in the singleplayer campaign?[/b]
[list]
[*] Given our desire for consistency between game modes, singleplayer gameplay will be fundamentally similar to multiplayer, only with a few twists. It takes a real force of nature to go up against an army, so Roka and her companions have access to powers and techniques that go well beyond what standard infantry can achieve.

While multiplayer characters are class-based, each with their own specialities, Roka plays more like a Swiss Army knife, and the missions she takes are designed to challenge her flexible skill set.
[/list]
[b]How is Galaxy in Turmoil funded?[/b]
[list]
[*] As of right now, we’re operating on an entirely volunteer basis. We plan to fund development of the full game with a Kickstarter campaign launched alongside the release of the upcoming demo. When the full multiplayer game is released, we’ll support further development with cosmetic microtransactions.

Unlike the multiplayer release, we’ll take a more traditional “pay-to-own” approach with the singleplayer campaign.
[/list]
[b]Wait, wasn’t the singleplayer campaign meant to be free too?[/b]
[list]
[*] We initially planned for both the multiplayer and singleplayer releases to be free. However, after much deliberation, we concluded that, while it would be practical to sustain a free multiplayer game through the sale of cosmetics, singleplayer games along the lines of what we have in mind are much more suited to a more traditional monetization model.
[/list]
[b]And what about those microtransactions?[/b]
[list]
[*] There are no plans for any microtransactions in the upcoming demo. However, we do plan to monetize the multiplayer release of Galaxy in Turmoil with optional directly-purchasable cosmetics.

The singleplayer release will most likely be sold for a one-time fee, allowing us to offer a complete narrative experience unblemished by further monetization. The extent to which we’ll offer post-launch content in singleplayer has yet to be determined, but our goal is for any hypothetical singleplayer DLC to enhance, not interfere with, the vanilla experience. None of those insufferable pop-up screens demanding a credit card number before you can reload your frag launcher![/list]
[b]What about lootboxes?[/b]
[list]
[*] We’re open to the idea of including something like a “lootbox” in the multiplayer release of Galaxy in Turmoil as an optional alternative to directly purchasable cosmetics. That said, we don’t believe players gracious enough to support us by purchasing skins should be forced to grind their teeth on an RNG system. If you want a specific skin, you should be able to buy it directly!
[/list]
[b]Are you planning on releasing DLC beyond the launch of the full game?[/b]
[list]
[*] This depends entirely on funding and player demand. If there’s demand for campaign expansions and the like - and we have the resources to provide them - we’d love to continue expanding our universe. However, when it comes to multiplayer, we don’t intend to do anything that would split our player base. If we release new multiplayer weapons, vehicles, elite characters, maps, or game modes, we believe they must be equally accessible to all players.
[/list]
[b]Will there be a beta?[/b]
[list]
[*] While we ourselves have been known to confuse terms in casual conversation, do note that there’s a difference between “beta” and “demo.” Based on our projected development cycle, the upcoming demo still qualifies as a glorified pre-alpha, meaning that, while it already has enough features to give you a taste of where we intend to go with the full game, and while it might have a bit more visual polish than you might expect from a pre-alpha, it is not “feature-complete” enough to qualify as an alpha. We won’t get into alpha or beta until we have funding to do this full-time.
[/list]
[b]Who can play the demo?[/b]
[list]
[*] Everyone (apart from Ned)! The upcoming demo will be completely free for all to play!
[/list]
[b]How many players are allowed in multiplayer?[/b]
[list]
[*] Our largest multiplayer game modes will support up to 64 players.

That said, we’re more than eager to increase that number in the full game if technical limitations allow and we have the funding to pull it off!
[/list]
[b]Will Galaxy in Turmoil support dedicated servers?[/b]
[list]
[*] Yes, we’ll release server binaries to allow players to host their own servers.
[/list]
[b]Will there be controller support?[/b]
[list]
[*] Controller support is planned for both the upcoming demo and full game.
[/list]
[b]What platforms will Galaxy in Turmoil be released on?[/b]
[list]
[*] The upcoming demo will be a Windows PC release only. The full game is planned to release on PC and PS4.
 
We are in talks with Microsoft about the possibility of bringing the full game to Xbox as well, but we can’t make any promises on that front just yet.
[/list]
[b]Will Linux and Mac OS be supported?[/b]
[list]
[*] Both are on the table for the full game and definitely something we’d like to do. That said, this is something that will largely come down to player demand and funding.
[/list]
[b]Will my PC be able to run it?[/b]
[list]
[*] There are no official estimated system requirements at this moment in time. This is something we’ll release later down the line.
[/list]
[b]Will Galaxy in Turmoil have a first person view?[/b]
[list]
[*] While the upcoming demo will be third person only, we’re more than open to including first person in the full game as well. Ultimately, this comes down to player demand and funding.
[/list]
[b]Will there be mod support?[/b]
[list]
[*] Some form of mod support is planned for the full release of Galaxy in Turmoil, but it’s too soon to offer details on the extent to which modding will be possible.
[/list]
[b]What ESRB/PEGI age rating will Galaxy in Turmoil be?[/b]
[list]
[*] We do not currently have an age rating for the game.
[/list]
[b]Can I help test development builds of Galaxy in Turmoil?[/b]
[list]
[*] We occasionally put out calls for volunteer playtesters on our [url=https://www.facebook.com/frontwirestudios/]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/frontwiregames]Twitter[/url], and [url=https://discord.gg/galaxyinturmoil]Discord[/url].
[/list]
[b]When will the next call for playtesters be?[/b]
[list]
[*] Whenever we need more playtesters than we currently have. We don’t have a schedule for this, and every call has a limited amount of slots, so keep your eyes peeled!
[/list]

[i][b]If you feel there’s a question we’ve missed, feel free to hit us up on our Discord server over at https://discord.gg/galaxyinturmoil or let us know in the comments below![/b][/i]

notes.title: Contact Information
notes.content:
[h1] Who to contact [/h1] 

Should you need to contact the Frontwire team for any reason, please refer to the following list:

legal@frontwirestudios.com
For any legal matters and/or concerns

press@frontwirestudios.com
For any and all press inquiries. Note: Press inquiries sent to individual staff members and/or posted on our community forums/social media profiles will NOT be responded to. All press inquires MUST be sent to the above email address

Please note:
Do not send requests for beta access to the above email addresses. Beta access will be granted to users signed up on our forums via random draw.

In addition, please do not submit your resume to any of our social media profiles and/or the above email addresses. Open positions with Frontwire Studios will be posted on our careers page which can be located by going to http://frontwirestudios.com 

We now have a support center where you can open up a support ticket to reach our team. Please open a ticket for the following issues:

Any DISCORD related issue (ban, etc)
Any FORUM related issue (ban, etc)
Any GiT technical issue (once released)
You can access the support center by going to http://support.frontwirestudios.com

Technical/billing support will [b]NOT[/b] be provided via the Steam community forums. All support requests must go through our support center listed above.
